#!/bin/bash

set -e

# Ensure the correct Python version is set up
PYTHON_VERSION="3.12.0"
pyenv install -f $PYTHON_VERSION
pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

# Confirm path is correctly set to use newly installed Python via pyenv
export PATH="/root/.pyenv/versions/$PYTHON_VERSION/bin:","$PATH"

# Install dependencies using pip if requirements.txt or setup.py is found
if [[ -f "requirements.txt" ]]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [[ -f "setup.py" ]]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [[ -f "pyproject.toml" ]]; then
    # If using Poetry, we manage the installation through it instead
    if command -v poetry &> /dev/null; then
        poetry install
    fi
else
    echo "No requirements found!"
fi

# Run tests
if command -v pytest &> /dev/null; then
    pytest
else
    echo "Testing framework pytest not found!"
    exit 1
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Specifying the required Python version
PYTHON_VERSION="3.9.18"

# Install the specific Python version using pyenv
pyenv install -f $PYTHON_VERSION
pyenv global $PYTHON_VERSION

# Check if pip is installed and setup required libraries
pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip

# Install required system packages
apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    clang-format \
    clang-tidy \
    doxygen \
    graphviz

# Assuming the current directory has setup.py or requirements.txt
if [ -f "setup.py" ]; then
    pip install -e .
elif [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then
    pip install -r requirements.txt
else
    echo "No setup.py or requirements.txt found, cannot install dependencies."
    exit 1
fi

# Run the project's automated tests using pytest
pytest
